bull_bear.body:
- Vertically integrated manufacturing with in-house pulp capacity (630 TPD), providing raw material security and cost control.
- Extensive domestic distribution network enabling highest-ever domestic sales of 2,58,550 MT and flexible pivoting between domestic and export markets.
- Modernized manufacturing platform following a C 520 Crore mill modernisation programme (2022-2026), enhancing product quality, productivity, and enabling a shift to premium/value-added grades.
- Established brand portfolio with strong growth in Maplitho and value-added products, supported by a 'Customer First' philosophy and high OTIF delivery rate (94.5%).
bull_bear.title: Bull — competitive strengths

bull_bear.body:
- Raw material availability and price volatility — Persistent inflation in wood and other input costs, coupled with raw material security concerns highlighted by industry bodies, directly impacts margins.
- Elevated imports and trade policy pressures — Surge in imports, particularly from China and ASEAN countries, results in subdued domestic price realisations and intensifying market competition.
- Environmental regulations and compliance costs — Evolving environmental regulations pose a structural risk, with major projects like the Tissue Paper project awaiting State Pollution Control Board approval for commencement.
- Margin compression from fixed charges of recently commissioned assets — Higher depreciation and finance costs arising from major capital expenditure programmes, combined with lower net sales realisations, structurally pressure profitability.
- Changing customer preferences and market dynamics — The need to continuously adapt product mix and invest in upgradation to meet changing customer needs in Writing & Printing and Value Added products is an ongoing strategic challenge.
bull_bear.title: Bear — key risks

business.body: Andhra Paper Limited manufactures and sells a wide range of writing, printing, industrial, and copier papers. The Company operates an integrated manufacturing platform with in-house pulp capacity, serving a diverse domestic customer base through a robust dealership network while also maintaining a small export presence. It is strategically expanding into value-added products and the high-growth tissue and hygiene segment.
business.title: What they do

business.body:
- **Writing & Printing:** Truprint Ultra, Truprint Ivory, Primavera White, Primavera, Write Choice, Splendor, Natural Shade Maplitho, Superprint Copier
- **Value-Added / Industrial:** Pharma Print, Plain Kraft NS Hi-BF, Straw Paper, Coating Base, Azurelaid, Stiffener, Poster, Cupstock

- Extensive domestic distribution network enabling highest-ever domestic sales of 2,58,550 MT and flexible pivoting between domestic and export markets.
- Modernized manufacturing platform following a C 520 Crore mill modernisation programme (2022-2026), enhancing product quality, productivity, and enabling a shift to premium/value-added grades.
- Established brand portfolio with strong growth in Maplitho and value-added products, supported by a 'Customer First' philosophy and high OTIF delivery rate (94.5%).
business.title: Competitive strengths

outlook.body:
- Comprehensive technological roadmap focusing on next-generation core application updates and infrastructure cloud mitigation
- Core ERP modernisation: transitioning SAP S/4HANA from version 1909 to 2025
- Cloud cost containment by implementing SAP Document Management System with local server at Rajahmundry Data Centre
- Enterprise wireless modernisation through complete lifecycle replacement of 15-year-old legacy Wi-Fi infrastructure
- Infrastructure relocation and application interfacing evolution to ICF2 framework
- The Company has a Dividend Distribution Policy approved by the Board, aimed at balancing shareholder returns with reinvestment needs, as part of its governance framework.
- Secured bronze medal in 'Industrial Safety Leadership Award' at CII Andhra Pradesh Industrial Safety Excellence Awards 2025 for Unit: Rajahmundry.
- Secured bronze medal in 'Industrial Safety Performer' category at CII Andhra Pradesh Industrial Safety Excellence Awards 2025 for Unit: Kadiyam.
- Received appreciation certificate from BIS for 'Zero failures of samples in last two years and continuous efforts to maintain quality of the products'.
outlook.title: Strategy & capital allocation

outlook.body: During FY 2025-26, the Company substantially completed its flagship mill modernisation programme across Rajahmundry and Kadiyam units. Plant upgrades and de-bottlenecking totalling ₹520 Crores were completed between 2022 and 2026. Key projects commissioned include Fibre Line Expansion (pulp capacity enhanced from 550 TPD to 630 TPD), Recovery Boiler and Ash Leaching Plant, Waste Paper Line Optimization (recycled pulp capacity upgraded to 110 TPD), Paper Machine Upgradations and Size Press Installations, and Environmental Infrastructure Projects (CNCG systems commissioned, DNCG systems progressing). The RJ-3 Paper Machine Rebuild and Upgradation Project (₹178 Crores) is in progress with target completion of March 2027. The 100 TPD Tissue Machine Project (₹270 Crores) is awaiting approval from State Pollution Control Board for commencement. Additionally, the Company invested ₹150 Crores in core manufacturing and process equipment, and ₹67 Crores in electrical, process control, warehousing, logistics, utilities, buildings, environmental systems, IT and safety systems.
outlook.title: Capex & expansion plans

outlook.body:
- Paper industry faces raw material availability and price volatility, increased imports, evolving trade policies, changing customer preferences, environmental regulations, and intensifying market competition
- Industry bodies have highlighted concerns relating to raw material security, import pressures, trade agreements, and need for supportive policy measures
outlook.title: Demand & outlook drivers

deepdive.thesis: Andhra Paper Limited is a leading Indian integrated pulp, paper, and paperboard manufacturer with a strong domestic distribution network, modernized manufacturing platform, and a strategic pivot into value-added and tissue segments.

open.item: Complete the transition of the exempted Provident Fund Trust to the EPFO framework, with the Company operating as an un-exempted establishment from 1 May 2026, subject to completion of statutory closure formalities.
Complete the RJ-3 Paper Machine Rebuild and Upgradation Project to improve machine productivity, product quality, and downstream utilisation of expanded pulp capacity.

Execute a comprehensive technological roadmap for FY 2026-27, including SAP S/4HANA version upgrade from 1909 to 2025, cloud cost containment via local DMS, enterprise wireless modernisation, and infrastructure relocation.
Meet the prescribed energy and emission reduction targets under the Carbon Credit Trading Scheme (CCTS) for the two-year compliance period covering FY 2025-26 and FY 2026-27.
